name: ai-delivery-insights
description: See what every GitHub Copilot chat session and prompt cost, by workspace, repo and user story, straight from your local logs. Optionally link stories to Azure DevOps.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: In a workspace you have not trusted, AI Delivery Insights does not contact Azure DevOps and does not read git history. The dashboard, stories and tags work as usual.

commands.title: Restore Stories and Tags from Backup...
Azure DevOps: Import Stories from the Backlog...
Azure DevOps: Set Personal Access Token (fallback)...

aiDeliveryInsights.monthlyAllowanceCredi.markdownDescription: Credits included in your Copilot plan each month (1 credit = $0.01, so Pro = 1000, Pro+ = 3900). When set, the dashboard shows a monthly meter. Leave at 0 to hide it.

aiDeliveryInsights.showStatusBar.description: Show credits used over the last 7 days in the status bar.

aiDeliveryInsights.extraDataDirs.markdownDescription: Extra VS Code `User` folders to scan, for example from another machine's backup or a custom `--user-data-dir`. Your own (user) settings only: a repository cannot set it.

aiDeliveryInsights.pricing.markdownDescription: Fallback rates in USD per 1M tokens, used only when Copilot did not record a billed cost. Keys match any part of the model name, e.g. `{ "claude-sonnet": { "input": 3, "cachedInput": 0.3, "output": 15 } }`. Your own (user) settings only: a repository cannot set it.

aiDeliveryInsights.notifyOnBudget.markdownDescription: Show a warning when a story goes over the credit budget you set for it. Shown once per story each time it crosses its budget.

enumDescriptions: The status bar number is credits over the last 7 days across every workspace on this machine.
The status bar number is credits over the last 7 days for this window's workspace only.
aiDeliveryInsights.statusBarScope.markdownDescription: Which total the status bar shows. The tooltip always shows both.

aiDeliveryInsights.ado.enabled.markdownDescription: Turn on the Azure DevOps pages. While this is off AI Delivery Insights makes no network requests at all. Use **AI Delivery Insights: Azure DevOps: Connect** to turn it on, so the choice is explicit.

aiDeliveryInsights.ado.organization.markdownDescription: Your Azure DevOps organisation, for example `contoso` (the part after `https://dev.azure.com/`). Only `https://dev.azure.com` is ever contacted. This setting is read from your user settings only; a workspace cannot change it.

aiDeliveryInsights.ado.project.markdownDescription: The project that holds your stories. Used as the default on the import page.

enumDescriptions: Sign in with your Microsoft account through VS Code (recommended).
Use a personal access token kept in VS Code's secret storage (fallback).
aiDeliveryInsights.ado.authMethod.markdownDescription: How AI Delivery Insights signs in to Azure DevOps.

aiDeliveryInsights.ado.storyTypes.markdownDescription: Work item types the import page lists as stories. Change this to match your process template (Agile: `User Story`, Scrum: `Product Backlog Item`, CMMI: `Requirement`, Basic: `Issue`).

aiDeliveryInsights.ado.shareName.markdownDescription: Include your Azure DevOps display name next to your sessions in the synced report. Off by default: sessions are then listed under a random ID made for this VS Code installation.

aiDeliveryInsights.effort.prodLinesPerDa.markdownDescription: Traditional effort estimate: how many lines of production code a developer finishes in a working day (lines added plus half of lines deleted). An assumption; set your team's own. Your own (user) settings only.

aiDeliveryInsights.effort.testLinesPerDa.markdownDescription: Traditional effort estimate: how many lines of test code a developer finishes in a working day. Your own (user) settings only.

aiDeliveryInsights.effort.hoursPerDay.markdownDescription: Traditional effort estimate: productive hours in a working day. Your own (user) settings only.

aiDeliveryInsights.effort.overheadPercen.markdownDescription: Traditional effort estimate: extra time on top of the coding for clarifying the story, review, rework and builds, as a percentage. Your own (user) settings only.

aiDeliveryInsights.effort.hoursPerPoint.markdownDescription: Optional cross-check: how many hours one story point usually takes in your team. When set, the effort page compares the estimate with points x hours. 0 turns the check off. Your own (user) settings only.
